subject: Reception and display joinery
hook: Long reception desk, standard door: how does it get in?
fb:
"It looks great on the drawing, but will it actually get in the building?"

It's a fair question for any business with a narrow entrance, a tight corridor or an upstairs unit. The answer is that a large reception desk rarely comes in as one piece.

We measure the whole route in at the site visit: doors, corridors, stairs and the lift if there is one. The desk is then built in sections in our Hanley workshop, each one sized to make it through, and our team joins them on site so it finishes as one continuous counter.

Have a question about your own premises? Ask below or get in touch for a consultation.

gbp:
Will a large reception desk fit through our door?

It doesn't need to arrive in one piece. When SUPERIO visits your premises, we measure the full route in: doors, corridors, stairs and any lift. Your reception desk or display unit is then built in sections in our own workshop in Hanley, Stoke-on-Trent, with each section sized to fit that route.

Our own team delivers the sections, joins them on site, levels the run and fits the top, so you end up with one continuous counter.

It's the same approach for long display walls and staff storage. Tap Learn more to get in touch about your premises.
